title: Leveraging large language models in pharmacometrics: evaluation of NONMEM output interpretation and simulation capabilities

content.abstract_summary: Evaluates Claude on diagrams, parameter tables, and reports derived from 44 NONMEM outputs, and ChatGPT on Python simulation for two PK models. Initial-prompt success was high for several presentation tasks, but complex structures, parameter extraction, calculations, and covariate-rich simulations required correction.
key_findings: Claude generated 40 of 44 model diagrams correctly on the initial prompt; iterative correction produced diagrams for all 44.
Claude produced 38 of 44 parameter tables successfully on the initial prompt, with errors involving initial/iteration values, OMEGA blocks, and CV calculations.
Eight of 44 generated reports initially omitted parameter values in models with many parameters.
ChatGPT generated simulations for meropenem and nivolumab, but the complex nivolumab clearance relationship still omitted covariate values after correction.
The study evaluates output translation and simulation, so a new diagnostics benchmark should claim novelty only for its engineered reasoning traps, current products, and blinded expert scoring.
limitations: Different LLM products were used for output interpretation and simulation tasks.
Only two relatively simple PK models were used for the simulation assessment.
Prompt correction was allowed but not structured as a uniform agentic retry budget.
The accessible detailed source was the author preprint corresponding to the published version.

extracted_claims.text: Claude generated model structure diagrams for 40 of 44 NONMEM outputs with the initial prompt, and the remaining cases were resolved with additional prompts.
Complex OMEGA structures and long parameter lists caused omissions or incorrect value extraction.
The covariate-rich nivolumab simulation required correction and still omitted some clearance covariate values.

numerical_findings.description: Model diagrams generated successfully from the initial prompt
Parameter tables generated successfully from the initial prompt
Meropenem simulation median Cmax and AUClast differences versus NONMEM

gaps_addressed: Provides the prior benchmark that M4.5-A6 must acknowledge and supplies concrete failure modes for M4.5-A7 output parsing and repair.

provenance.notes: Publication metadata verified through PubMed. Detailed Methods and Results were reviewed in the openly accessible author preprint linked to the version of record.
